run_forward_mode_fixed_point_solver: run the fixed-point iterative solver for the forward mode extended Lengyel model
run_inverse_mode_fixed_point_solver: run the fixed-point iterative solver for the inverse mode extended Lengyel model
run_forward_mode_newton_solver: run the Newton-Raphson solver for the forward mode extended Lengyel model
run_inverse_mode_newton_solver: run the Newton-Raphson solver for the inverse mode extended Lengyel model
run_forward_mode_hybrid_solver: run the hybrid fixed-point then Newton-Raphson solver for the forward mode extended Lengyel model
